name: @bubstack/moe-glass
description: Direct Chrome DevTools Protocol access. Skill mode plus MCP mode, zero dependencies.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-package-dist.mjs && cd ../.. && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs --prepare packages/glass && tsc -b packages/glass/tsconfig.json --force && esbuild packages/glass/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=packages/glass/dist/index.js --external:fsevents --metafile=packages/glass/.moe-build/metafile-esm.json && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs packages/glass packages/glass/.moe-build/metafile-esm.json
